scanner_c.notes: Strict Sep 9 Toronto-morning 24-hour scan across the U.S., mainland China/Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and Europe. Technology and U.S.-equity read-through were prioritized. Reuters was preferred for major claims; additional major-outlet reporting was used where useful. Ten distinct topics were retained without duplicate padding.

items.event_title: Qualcomm strikes long-term AI chip and optical-networking deal with Amazon
items.news_summary: Qualcomm and Amazon agreed to develop AI data-center chips and optical networking. Reuters reported a framework allowing Amazon to buy up to $60 billion of products and warrants worth roughly $4 billion.
items.investor_materiality: A major hyperscaler customer materially strengthens Qualcomm's push into AI data centers and creates competitive read-through for Nvidia, Broadcom and custom silicon.
items.selection_reason: Large named customer, multi-year AI infrastructure economics and direct semiconductor competition make this the strongest corporate tech catalyst in the window.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters reported the commercial framework and warrant economics; exact product purchases will depend on future deployments.
items.youtube_query: Qualcomm QCOM Amazon AI chip deal
items.video_angle: 高通突然拿下AWS AI芯片大单：QCOM是在复制Broadcom，还是开始正面抢NVIDIA的数据中心生意？

items.event_title: Google to invest at least €13 billion in Finland AI infrastructure and nuclear power
items.news_summary: Google announced at least €13 billion of AI-infrastructure investment in Finland over two years and signed a 22-year agreement with Fortum for up to half of output from the Loviisa nuclear plant.
items.investor_materiality: The deal is a major hyperscaler capex and power-procurement signal with read-through to data centers, grids, nuclear power, cooling and AI hardware demand.
items.selection_reason: One of the largest fresh European AI-infrastructure commitments and a concrete example of power becoming a binding AI input.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters reported Google's investment amount and Fortum power-purchase terms.
items.youtube_query: GOOGL Google Finland AI data center nuclear power
items.video_angle: Google为什么一口气砸150亿美元去芬兰，还直接锁核电？AI下一阶段真正争的可能不是GPU，而是电。

items.event_title: OpenAI deepens Samsung ties on next-generation chips and enterprise AI
items.news_summary: OpenAI said it is making progress with Samsung on next-generation chip development and broader enterprise AI cooperation. Samsung and SK Hynix also have memory-supply ties to Stargate.
items.investor_materiality: The partnership links frontier-model demand to Samsung memory/foundry exposure and to TSMC, Broadcom and the broader AI semiconductor stack.
items.selection_reason: Fresh chip-development cooperation involving one of the world's largest semiconductor companies and OpenAI has strong supply-chain relevance.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters directly quotes OpenAI Korea; detailed chip scope remains undisclosed.
items.youtube_query: OpenAI Samsung next generation chip Stargate memory
items.video_angle: OpenAI和三星到底在做什么芯片？这件事对TSMC、Broadcom、HBM和Stargate供应链分别意味着什么？

items.event_title: DeepSeek taps CITIC Securities to prepare mainland China IPO
items.news_summary: Reuters reported DeepSeek has hired CITIC Securities to prepare for a Shanghai STAR Market IPO and aims to begin the process in 2026.
items.investor_materiality: A DeepSeek listing would create a new public valuation benchmark for Chinese frontier AI and affect expectations for compute spending, Nvidia alternatives and Chinese cloud/AI peers.
items.selection_reason: A concrete step toward listing by one of China's highest-profile AI firms, not just generic IPO speculation.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters cites people with knowledge of the matter; timing and valuation are not finalized.
items.video_angle: DeepSeek终于要上市了？如果走科创板，它会给中国AI公司定出什么估值锚，也会怎样影响NVIDIA中国故事？

items.event_title: China reportedly tightens humanoid-robot IPO approvals after Unitree volatility
items.news_summary: Reuters, citing The Information, reported Chinese regulators are raising the bar for humanoid-robot IPOs after Unitree's volatile debut and subsequent sharp decline.
items.investor_materiality: Tighter listing standards can cool robotics valuations and affect capital availability across the China humanoid supply chain, with read-through to Tesla's Optimus narrative and global robotics multiples.
items.selection_reason: A fresh policy response to a highly speculative AI/robotics segment with clear valuation and funding implications.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters could not independently confirm the informal guidance, so present it as reported policy guidance rather than a formal rule.
items.youtube_query: China humanoid robot IPO Unitree regulation
items.video_angle: 宇树上市暴涨后又大跌，中国开始给人形机器人IPO降温：这会不会戳破机器人估值泡沫？

items.event_title: Brent breaches $100 as Middle East conflict raises supply and inflation risk
items.news_summary: Brent moved above $100 as Houthi attacks on Saudi cities and broader U.S.-Iran conflict intensified concerns over Middle East supply and shipping disruptions.
items.investor_materiality: Oil above $100 directly feeds inflation expectations, bond yields, Fed pricing, energy equities and valuation pressure on long-duration U.S. tech stocks.
items.selection_reason: The strongest cross-asset macro catalyst in the window, with immediate implications for rates and equity multiples.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters market reporting includes live crude prices and geopolitical context.
items.youtube_query: Brent $100 Iran Saudi oil Fed stocks
items.video_angle: 油价重新站上100美元后，美股真正要怕的不是能源股，而是通胀、利率和科技股估值一起被重定价。

items.event_title: Chime surges after $590 million Stride Bank acquisition puts it on path to bank charter
items.news_summary: Chime agreed to acquire Stride Bank for about $590 million, giving the fintech a path toward a national bank charter. Shares rose about 11%.
items.investor_materiality: Owning a bank charter can improve unit economics, product control and lending expansion for a U.S.-listed fintech with a market value above $10 billion.
items.selection_reason: A concrete acquisition with immediate double-digit stock reaction and a structural change to Chime's business model.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters reports deal value, stock reaction and expected strategic benefits.
items.youtube_query: Chime CHYM Stride Bank acquisition charter
items.video_angle: Chime花5.9亿美元买下一张银行牌照：这一步会不会把它从“金融App”直接变成真正的银行？

items.event_title: GameStop beats estimates as collectibles overtake video games and raises EBITDA outlook
items.news_summary: GameStop reported adjusted EPS of $0.27 versus $0.19 expected and revenue of $790.2 million versus $756.8 million expected. Collectibles rose 57% and became the largest sales category; the company raised full-year adjusted EBITDA guidance.
items.investor_materiality: The results show a meaningful business-model mix shift and improved profitability in one of the market's highest-attention retail stocks.
items.selection_reason: Fresh earnings plus an unusual collectibles-led transformation give a concrete fundamental story beneath the meme-stock attention.
references: Reuters-sourced earnings report via Investing.com, Sep. 8-9, 2026
items.source_quality_note: The report reproduces Reuters earnings figures; company filings should be used for final production details.
items.video_angle: GameStop现在卖收藏品比卖游戏还多：这家公司是不是已经悄悄换了一个商业模式？

items.event_title: Japan manufacturer confidence hits near five-year high on semiconductor and data-center demand
items.news_summary: A Reuters Tankan poll showed sentiment among large Japanese manufacturers rising to its highest level since December 2021, helped by semiconductor and data-center demand.
items.investor_materiality: The survey is a fresh cross-check that AI/data-center spending is supporting Japanese industrial, equipment and semiconductor demand ahead of BOJ policy decisions.
items.selection_reason: A broad real-economy confirmation of AI capex strength rather than a single-stock headline.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters monthly poll of large Japanese companies; it is a sentiment indicator rather than official Tankan data.
items.youtube_query: Japan semiconductor data center demand Reuters Tankan
items.video_angle: 日本制造业信心冲到近5年最高：AI资本开支是不是已经从GPU扩散到整个亚洲工业链？

items.event_title: ASML breaks ground on major new production campus as AI lithography demand expands
items.news_summary: ASML began construction on a 35-hectare expansion near Eindhoven, with first-phase facilities due by 2029 and room for up to 20,000 workers. Nearly all EUV capacity is booked through 2027.
items.investor_materiality: The expansion is a tangible capacity response to sustained demand from TSMC, Samsung, Intel and Micron and reinforces the durability of semiconductor equipment capex.
items.selection_reason: Concrete multiyear capacity build by the monopoly supplier of EUV lithography with direct AI semiconductor read-through.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters reports the project scale, timeline and current capacity-booking context.
items.youtube_query: ASML new campus EUV capacity AI chips
items.video_angle: ASML开始扩建超级工厂，而且EUV产能几乎排满到2027：AI芯片资本开支到底还有多长的尾巴？
